response.original_title: The Cumbrian Murders The Untold Story
response.overview: On Wednesday, June 2nd, 2010, a mild-mannered taxi driver named Derrick Bird embarked on a deadly shooting rampage, leaving twelve people dead and many more injured in the peaceful rural communities of West Cumbria.  Featuring in-depth interviews with those who knew Bird, along with access to witnesses and victims, this documentary attempts to shed light on these tragic events.
response.tagline: The Cumbrian Murders: The Untold Story
response.title: The Cumbrian Murders The Untold Story
